description: Hello #TeamCastro! We are 48 days until the election, and it feels like the roller coaster is speeding up. Thank you to everyone who has donated funds, time stamps and encouragement to this campaign. It is the backbone of our outreach and success. Here's some recent good news: I've had several endorsements come through recently, including Planned Parenthood Action Fund, Human Rights Campaign PAC, Southern Regional Council of Carpenters and Communications Workers of America. I am honored to have gained their trust and support. This puts us at 26 endorsements for our campaign, with several on the horizon! And the big news? Our district has been polled, and the data confirms SD 37 is a VERY flippable seat! We knew this before based on the voting trends of past elections, but now we have updated metrics that even more strongly point in our favor. What this means now... My sense of urgency has grown. Early voting starts in less than a month. Now is a CRUCIAL time for us to raise the funds we need to get the word out and gather our volunteers to talk to voters directly. I know we can do this. You all have continued to be enthusiastic for positive change in SD 37. Let's be strong together as we sprint towards the finish line! See below for upcoming opportunities to help! We need you, #TeamCastro!!!!! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37 (NOTE FOR OUR REGULAR WEDNESDAY NIGHT VOLUNTEERS: We are taking two weeks off because I have events I need to attend, but we will start phonebanking as a team on September 30th!)
title: News from Darcy Castro
